<br clear="all">
==Usage==
To create a set of tabs, use these four elements. Keep the page tabs in the same order on all pages, use "Tab1" for the current page, and use "Tab2" for all others.

{{tl|TabsTop}}<br/>
{{tlx|Tab1|Current page name}}<br/>
{{tlx|Tab2|<nowiki>[[</nowiki>Other page name(s)<nowiki>]]</nowiki>}}<br/>
{{tl|TabsBottom}}

==Example==
Using optional variables color, bgcolor, bordercolor (magenta, yellow, cyan):
<code><nowiki>{{Tab1|Tab1|color=#d9138a|bgcolor=#e2d810|bordercolor=#12a4d9}}</nowiki></code>

Produces:
{{TabsTop}}
{{Tab2|[[Template:TabsTop|TabsTop]]}}
{{Tab1|Tab1|color=#d9138a|bgcolor=#e2d810|bordercolor=#12a4d9}}
{{Tab2|[[Template:Tab2|Tab2]]}}
{{Tab2|[[Template:TabsBottom|TabsBottom]]}}
{{TabsBottom}}
